```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(nanoparquet)
library(here)
library(tidybayes)
library(nanoparquet)
library(patchwork)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
model <- brm(
  formula = foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo_7,
  data = data_sample_full_agg,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior = prior_custom_vs_mo,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  file = (here::here("06_model-validation", "model.rds"))
)

data <- read_parquet(here("02_data", "02-3_data_modeling", "sample_359266_factor.parquet"))

data <- data |> 
  mutate(defender_foul_count = factor(defender_foul_count, 
                                   levels = 0:5,
                                   ordered = TRUE))

data <- data |> 
  group_by(offensive_team, defensive_team, primary_defender, shot_movement, shot_type_basic, shot_zone, defender_position, defender_foul_count) |> 
  summarize(shots_defended_made = sum(shots_defended_made),
         shots_defended_total = sum(shots_defended_total))
```

```{r}
mcmc_plot(model)  
```

```{r}
plot(model)
```

```{r}
marginal_effects(model)
```

```{r}
neff_plot <- neff_ratio(model) |> mcmc_neff() + labs(title = "Neff Values for Binomial Model",
                                                     subtitle = "Above 0.1 is good"
                                                     )

ggsave(here::here("07_model-analysis", "07-01_figures", "neff_plot.png"), neff_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r}
pp_check(model)

mcmc_areas
```


```{r}
model |> 
  gather_draws(r_shot_zone[shot_zone,]) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = shot_zone, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye()

model |> 
   gather_draws(r_shot_movement[shot_movement,]) |> 
   ggplot(aes(y = shot_movement, x = .value)) + 
   stat_halfeye()

model |> 
  gather_draws(r_defender_position[defender_position,]) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = defender_position, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye()

model |>
  gather_draws(r_shot_zone[shot_zone,]) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = shot_zone, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye()

model |>
  gather_draws(r_defensive_team[defensive_team,]) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = defensive_team, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye()

# Get median values for each team and term combination
mo_def_foul_order_data <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_defensive_team[defensive_team,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "modefender_foul_count") |> 
  group_by(defensive_team, term) |>
  summarise(median_value = median(.value), .groups = "drop")

# Plot using the original data but order teams based on medians
mo_def_foul_plot <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_defensive_team[defensive_team,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "modefender_foul_count") |> 
  mutate(defensive_team = factor(defensive_team, 
                               levels = mo_def_foul_order_data |> 
                                 filter(term == term[1]) |> 
                                 arrange(median_value) |> 
                                 pull(defensive_team))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = defensive_team, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye() +
  labs(title = "Effect of fouls on\nopponent shotmaking percentage",
       y = "Defensive Team")
  

# Get median values for each team and term combination
team_order_data <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_defensive_team[defensive_team,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "Intercept") |> 
  group_by(defensive_team, term) |>
  summarise(median_value = median(.value), .groups = "drop")

# Plot using the original data but order teams based on medians
team_plot <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_defensive_team[defensive_team,term]) |> 
  filter(term == "Intercept") |> 
  mutate(defensive_team = factor(defensive_team, 
                               levels = team_order_data |> 
                                 filter(term == term[1]) |> 
                                 arrange(median_value) |> 
                                 pull(defensive_team))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = defensive_team, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye() +
  labs(title = "Baseline team effect on\nopponent shotmaking percentage",
       y = "Defensive Team")

bisect_plot <- team_plot | mo_def_foul_plot

# Get median values for each team and term combination
team_order_comb_data <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_defensive_team[defensive_team,]) |> 
  group_by(defensive_team) |>
  summarise(median_value = median(.value), .groups = "drop")

# Plot using the original data but order teams based on medians
team_comb_plot <- model |>
  gather_draws(r_defensive_team[defensive_team,]) |> 
  mutate(defensive_team = factor(defensive_team, 
                               levels = team_order_comb_data |> 
                                 arrange(median_value) |> 
                                 pull(defensive_team))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = defensive_team, x = .value)) + 
  stat_halfeye() +
  labs(title = "Total team effect on\nopponent shotmaking percentage",
       y = "Defensive Team")

ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "bisect_plot.png"), bisect_plot, width = 10, height = 8)

ggsave(here("07_model-analysis", "team_comb_plot.png"), team_comb_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
```
